name: Tigress in Silent Repose
effectText: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 Spell/Trap your opponent controls; destroy that card when this card leaves the field. If this card is sent from the hand or field to the GY: You can send 1 Spell/Trap you control to the GY; Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use each effect of "Tigress in Silent Repose" once per turn.
